translations.text: To you be glory and praise, revealed far and wide among all nations, thanks and goodwill, power and mercy, and the love of every heart, the peace of the righteous,
and your own glory made beautiful in the world, since you can rule all the might of the earth and the upper air, wind and clouds. You rule all things rightly.
You are the father of comforts and guardian of life, the leader of life, the ruler of light, set apart from sins,
as is your glorious Son, by his pure nature, king over all, bold and blessed, teacher of books, and the high comforter of the mind, the Holy Spirit.
So the Lord of mankind was in the beginning, the beauty and comfort of all the world, pure and mighty.
You made it known when you, eternal God, alone created through your holy might the heavens and the earth, the dwelling-places and the upper air, and all things.
You set very many kinds of creatures on the earth and afterwards divided them into multitudes. You created all creatures in six days, eternal God, and on the seventh you rested.
Then your fair work was completed, and you yourself hallowed Sunday and glorified it as a help to many.
That high day is kept and cherished by all who know Christian customs, holy love of the heart, and the command of the Highest. The day is honoured in the Lord's name.
And now and always your true works and your great might are shown to many, as they make your powers known far and wide over all the world. God's handiwork stands forever and grows as you commanded.
All holy joys praise you with pure voice, and so do Christian books and all the earth, and we men here on the ground say: "To God be praise and thanks, eternal goodwill, and your own glory!"

And for ever and ever the King dwells and reigns in glory, and with him his chosen ones: the high majesty of the Holy Spirit, beautiful angels and the gift of glory, true peace, the thanksgiving of souls, mercy of heart.
There is the greatest love. The heavens of holiness are full everywhere through your eternal word, just as your powers over the earth are plain and visible, showing that you yourself made them.
We all truly say this: by your pure nature you are King by right, pure and mighty.

You made it known when you, mighty God, made man and put breath and soul into him, and gave him speech and understanding and the nature to bear fruit. You made your powers known. Such is Christ's might!
